name: f1-manager-light
description: Historical Formula 1 management game built with React, Vite and a JSON-backed simulation database.

scripts.check: npm run test:career && npm run test:drivers && npm run test:simulation && npm run test:management && npm run test:save-safety && npm run test:race-entry && npm run test:injuries && npm run test:health && npm run test:season-packs && npm run validate:data && npm run build
scripts.season:generate: npm run build:data && node scripts/build-team-seasons.mjs && node scripts/build-driver-history.mjs && node scripts/build-season-packs.mjs
scripts.season:generate:test-years: npm run build:data && node scripts/build-team-seasons.mjs && node scripts/build-driver-history.mjs && node scripts/build-season-packs.mjs --years=1975,1980,1987,1989,1999,2014,2020
